title: Abstract nouns you will meet everywhere
intro: These are the words that fill newspapers and conversations about anything serious. Several are masculine despite ending in -a, because they come from Greek: el tema, el sistema, el programa, el problema.

entries.note: Masculine. cambiar de tema is to change the subject.

ex.en: Let's get back to the main point.

entries.note: Masculine, like all the Greek -ma nouns.

ex.en: The system doesn't work properly.

entries.note: en todo caso means in any case; hacer caso a means to pay attention to.

ex.en: In that case, we'd better wait.

entries.note: de hecho means in fact. Also the past participle of hacer, done or made.

ex.es: El hecho es que no llamó.
ex.en: The fact is he didn't call.
They judge him by his deeds.

ex.es: El carro está en buen estado.
ex.en: The car is in good condition.
It's a state school.
The situation changed completely.

entries.note: en mi vida means never in my life; toda la vida always, forever.

ex.es: Nunca en mi vida había visto eso.
ex.en: I'd never seen that in my life.

entries.note: muerto is dead, and also the past participle of morir.

ex.es: Su muerte nos sorprendió a todos.
ex.en: His death surprised us all.

entries.note: a la fuerza means by force or of necessity.

ex.en: I haven't the strength to lift it.

entries.note: Same word as the verb poder, to be able — see unit 1.

ex.en: Power corrupts.

entries.note: libre is free in the sense of unconstrained; gratis is free of charge.

ex.en: They were fighting for their freedom.

entries.note: Plural paces. hacer las paces is to make up after a quarrel.

ex.en: They signed the peace in 1996.
The war lasted ten years.
Society has changed a lot.
They founded a company in 1990.

entries.note: See unit 8. In political contexts the first sense dominates.

ex.es: El pueblo decidió en las urnas.
ex.en: The people decided at the ballot box.

ex.es: Nació en un pueblo del sur.
ex.en: He was born in a village in the south.

entries.note: como resultado de means as a result of.

ex.es: El resultado fue mejor de lo esperado.
ex.en: The result was better than expected.

entries.note: a causa de means because of — a tidier alternative to porque before a noun.

ex.es: Se canceló a causa de la lluvia.
ex.en: It was cancelled because of the rain.

entries.note: en efecto means indeed; el efecto secundario a side effect.

ex.en: The medicine took effect straight away.

entries.note: la ocasión is an occasion, and in shops a bargain.

ex.es: Es una oportunidad que no se repite.
ex.en: It's a chance that won't come again.

entries.note: a diferencia de means unlike; dar igual means to make no difference.

ex.en: I can't see the difference.

entries.note: con relación a means with regard to.

ex.en: They have a good relationship.

ex.es: No hay relación entre los dos casos.
ex.en: There's no connection between the two cases.
